rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday way to describe someone confident in their own abilities.

example.english: 阿明 has always been self-confident and never gets nervous speaking in front of people.
example.traditional: 阿明由細到大都好有自信，喺人哋面前講嘢從來唔怯。
example.jyutping: aa3 ming4 jau4 sai3 dou3 daai6 dou1 hou2 jau5 zi6 seon3 hai2 jan4 dei6 min6 cin4 gong2 je5 cung4 loi4 m4 hip3

rows.note: Use this when the confidence is about succeeding at a particular task or using a particular ability.

example.english: We feel self-confident about winning tomorrow's match.
example.traditional: 聽日場波我哋有信心贏。
example.jyutping: ting1 jat6 coeng4 bo1 ngo5 dei6 jau5 seon3 sam1 jeng4
